description: Land Title Settlement Department - Karamada, Udunuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320249
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including details of land owners, property locations, extents, and encumbrances. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land ownership and property rights, which clearly falls under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
